name: exomiser-benchmark
description: Benchmarks phenotype-driven variant prioritization and gene/variant ranking performance using real or simulated clinical exomes. It measures how well methods rank the causal gene/variant given patient phenotypes and genomic data, enabling comparison of prioritization algorithms.
evaluation_method: Top-k recall and rank-based metrics (e.g., Top-1/Top-5 recall, MRR)
general_score_metric: Top-k recall (Top-1, Top-5) / Mean Reciprocal Rank
typical_sota_score: Top-1: ~30–60%; Top-5: ~60–90% (varies by dataset and phenotype quality)
reputation: Well-regarded within clinical genomics and variant-prioritization research as a practical benchmarking resource.
